queued

fields.description: waiting_capacity (chat-concurrency CDX-19): the step could not be admitted because the site's turn queue was momentarily full. The run does NOT advance; the capacity-resume cron re-attempts the same step next cycle (bounded by capacity_attempts, then failed).

fields.label: Run Mode
fields.description: #470: the shape this run was DISPATCHED in - the whole step sequence (stepped) or the macro's summarized single prompt (merged). Snapshotted at insert and never rewritten, so a macro edited while the run is parked in waiting_capacity cannot flip it mid-flight. Deliberately has NO default: the blank a pre-#470 row gets on migrate is what tells the resume path to fall back instead of trusting a value nobody wrote.

fields.label: Capacity Attempts
fields.description: CDX-19: how many times the capacity-resume cron has re-attempted a waiting_capacity step. Bounded: once it exceeds the ceiling the run fails with an honest 'site stayed busy' reason instead of retrying forever.
Why the run failed or stopped. On a completed run, a note (a step that only drafted a record). Empty when the run simply worked, or the user stopped it.
fields.label: Reason / Note
Steps Snapshot
fields.description: What the run started with, as JSON: each step's prompt, skills and overrides, Stop on error and the summarized prompt. The engine reads it instead of the macro while the run is live, so an edit applies from the next run. Written with the run row, cleared when the run ends. Empty on a run started before it existed: such a run reads the macro, as it always did.

fields.label: Waiting On
fields.description: JSON list of the Prepared Reports the parked step is waiting for: each {prepared_report, report_name, filters}. Written only inside the CAS that moves the run to waiting_report.

fields.label: Waiting Since
fields.description: When the run parked in waiting_report. The wait deadline counts from here.

fields.label: Resume Turn
fields.description: Id of the continuation turn sent when the awaited reports were ready. Once set, it is the only turn that ends the current step. Cleared in the CAS that moves the cursor.

fields.label: Resume Count
fields.description: Continuations sent over the whole run (capped).

fields.label: Step Resumes
fields.description: Continuations sent for the current step (capped). Reset when the cursor moves.

fields.label: Resume Compensations
fields.description: Times a continuation that failed to go out was put back to waiting_report (capped).

fields.label: Waiting Failed
fields.description: An awaited report failed: the continuation is the write-less explanation turn, after which the run ends failed.

fields.label: Waited
fields.description: The run parked for a report at least once; its owner is notified of any terminal outcome.

fields.label: Step Continuations
fields.description: JSON {step_index: last continuation turn id}, written when a continuation goes out and never cleared; a resumed step is judged by it.
